title: InvertedPendulum: Hybrid Behavioral Cloning with Synthetic Data
summary: A reinforcement-learning project that trains a PPO expert on the InvertedPendulum-v5 environment and augments limited expert demonstrations with synthetic trajectory data to train hybrid behavioral-cloning agents. It generates that synthetic data using the standalone ctgan package and DeepEcho's PARModel (with an SDV sequential-modeling import left commented out in favor of deepecho), so the SDV-family ctgan and deepecho packages are directly imported and run as the generative data-augmentation backbone.
evidence: generate_synth_data.py: 'model = CTGAN.load(...)' and 'synth_df = model.sample(100000)'; train_par_model.py imports 'from deepecho import PARModel' after commenting out sdv.sequential.PARModel
needs: industry classification uncertain since this is RL control research with no clear domain fit besides cross_industry
